name: Wendy's Chili (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Contains red kidney beans and pinto beans loaded with insoluble skins and fermentable oligosaccharides, simmered with diced onions, garlic, green peppers, chili powder, and greasy burger trimmings. A notorious cause of severe cramps, bloating, and painful bowel obstruction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. One of the highest-risk items on any fast-food menu for inflammatory bowel disease.
